categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches the RPC/REST/ZMQ label, modifies HTTP server setup in src/httpserver.cpp, and updates rpc_bind functional tests.
categories.rationale: Prevents local credential theft by ensuring the HTTP server fails closed if IPv4 binding fails instead of falling back to IPv6-only. Under current behavior, if IPv4 binding fails but IPv6 succeeds, the daemon writes an RPC cookie while `bitcoin-cli` defaults to IPv4, sending plain-text cookie credentials to any rogue process listening on the local port.
